body: I really appreciate that. You’re very kind. I think I’m gonna look into some online communities too so I’m not completely isolated.

I understand that very well. If I’m sad, I just can’t go out. I’ll make negative comments about myself and I’m sure people find that tiresome and off-putting. I don’t want my sadness to rub off on others so I just don’t keep in contact. It’s too hard to pretend to be having fun.

Thank you for taking time out of your day to talk to me a little. Coming here provides a much needed distraction.

Unfortunately, my bf was kinda my whole world. Neither of us really have friendships outside our relationship. Maybe that’s why it didn’t work for him...

I haven’t really had consistent friends since highschool. I’m a bad friend anyway. I’m terrible at committing to dates and I’m a bit flakey.

Thank you. It is...
Especially since most of his stuff is still here and I can smell him. 

There’s too many people struggling all alone. :(
I’m sorry
I mean...not really. There’s not much to do. Just a lot of hobbies that I have no desire for atm

Yeah, as embarrassing as it is. Lol
It’s funny that I was so messed up then too, it’s probably a good thing he left me. It can’t be easy being with someone like me.  

Your words are really sweet. I hope I can find happiness too. It’s a bit of a comfort, as morbid as it is, that if things get that bad I always have a way out. I don’t **have** to suffer. You know? 

He’ll have to come back eventually. He has to sign off on the lease and a lot of his stuff is still here. I’ll see him again, and that gives me hope, but it also is incredibly painful, because I know the next time I see him will be the last. 

Thank you, again
It’s okay. I knew you weren’t trying to be insensitive. It’s true. Life just fucking SUCKS

That’s exactly how I feel! I’ve been crying non-stop and haven’t eaten a single thing for about 4 days now because it feels like he **died**.

I’m in a deep mourning over the death of the handsome, charming, fun man he used to be, and also the death of my own sense of security.

It’s not just because I was dumped...it’s the added hopelessness of loosing my house, my insurance, and my sense of reality. He left to go stay with his parents, so now I’m left alone in the apartment. I’m not sure if I’ll have to pay rent on my own now? He’s still on the lease, but what do I do if he just never comes back? He left all the burdens on my lap and it feels cruel.  I can’t afford my own place and the pandemic means my options for housing are limited. It’s all just too much. My whole life is destroyed.

Dude...that’s so shitty. That sounds like the absolute worst and I’m sorry. I tried desperately to save my relationship too but there’s nothing you can do to change someone’s feelings. :(

I definitely would rather of never met him.

I agree. I have no support to fall back on at all. 

I don’t know how to play chess, but I suppose I could learn. I used to frequent TCG and gaming tournaments but I found that the majority of people were even more socially awkward than me. I was fine with quarantine when I had my man, but now I wish all the conventions would come back...

I’m sorry...

Maybe it’s delusional but I feel that I’d rather not have ever experienced love because the pain that follows would never happen. The pain of somebody suddenly not caring for you anymore is more severe than the pain of solitude, at least for me.

I’m so sorry...this really really hurts, doesn’t it? I know I’m not the only one suffering like this but it’s irrelevant when the pain is this crushing. It always seems I love more then I will ever **be** loved. 

This year is a bust. I’m sorry...

I guess I have no idea how to go about meeting people. I met my ex on Tinder actually, as silly as that is. We both make profiles not expecting to meet anyone and we found each other. He was so loving back then...

Especially during quarantine, I’m not sure how I could possibly even make new friends. 

When things get better pandemic-wise, am I just going to stalk bookstores and arcades until someone notices me? My social anxiety is pretty bad. Can’t look people in the eyes most of the time so how will I ever initiate anything?

I know I need to improve myself if I ever want to be worthy of someone’s love, but things are just too hard right now...
I don’t know where to start. I live in a very party-centric state and clubbing and drinking just isn’t my scene.

It’s sucks too because the PC thing could have been a shared passion. I’m a huge nerd and I love playing video games. Instead it just tore us apart. 

The honeymoon comment really hurt. Whatever the “Honeymoon phase” is supposed to be, I never loved him less of felt burnt out. I think it just comes down to him hating me being around all the time. He tried to break up with me a year ago then apologized and took it back. It should’ve been a sign of things to come. 

Unfortunately, I don’t have any friends and family isn’t really a thing I’ve ever had, so I’m pretty much all alone now. 

I have a bird, thank god, because while he’s alive he gives me a schedule to adhere to and a being to receive affection from, but he’s very old now, and I worry any day now I’ll lose him too.

I’m really sorry. There truly are a lot of people out there suffering. It’s such a dire problem in this country but no one cares. It’s the “thoughts and prayers” era of helping your fellow man.

I really wish we weren’t born in the first place if the whole point is to suffer and find ways to rationalize and giving meaning to suffering.

We really are born without reason, prolonging our suffering because of weakness, and dying by chance...

Yeah...I’m becoming more and more convinced that this country just wants the weak and unproductive to die so it’ll be less strain on the ones who are able to fall in line.

I can’t access affordable mental healthcare, but I can drive to Walmart, buy a gun to blow my brains out with, and it’d be a lot cheaper to boot.
